facts.business: BEML Limited manufactures and supplies defence equipment, railway and metro rolling stock, and mining and construction equipment.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management expects order inflows to remain strong during FY 2026–27

auditor.name: M/s. MMA & Partners (Formerly known as M/s Manish Mishra & Associates)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Revised audit report superseding earlier report dated 29 May 2026 concurring to the opinion of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India under Section 143(6) of the Companies Act, 2013 only with respect to certain disclosures in the financial statements as stated in the Other Matter paragraph.

key_risks: One-time accounting provisions for supplier price escalation and foreign exchange impact in metro projects
Expected contract losses on long-duration contracts
Statutory impact from revision of gratuity ceiling
High estimation uncertainty in onerous contract provisions
